Special mention

First place at the robotics qualifiers, and on to the nationals in Abu Dhabi

At the Unified Robotics competition, Syed Ahmed took gold in the Robotics Game, finishing first in the qualifiers. That win earns him a place at the national finals in Abu Dhabi on 25 January 2027, the biggest stage he has reached so far.
